caveats: Estimated mapping of KNBS 345 zone to real 290 sub county boundaries
name: kenyacencusict2019
notes:
Kenya 2019 Census ICT Usage data mapped by Subcounty
Note KNBS incorrectly used 345 sub counties.  This is mapped by best effort to 290 correct sub counties using IEBC boundaries.  Acknowledgements to Shel Kariuki who imported KNBS PDFS to CSV and Brian Mwangi who helped with mapping KNBS regions to valid sub county names.

organization.title: Liquid Intelligent Technologies (inactive)
organization.description:
Liquid Telecom is a leading communications solutions provider across 13 countries primarily in Eastern, Central and Southern Africa that serves mobile operators, carriers, enterprise, media and content companies and retail customers with high-speed, reliable connectivity, hosting and co-location and digital services. 
Liquid Telecom has partnered with Humanitarian organizations such as the UNICEF to map school locations around Africa and also on other humanitarian projects
